about: Regression for the v1.4.7 transfer-cell load bugs: after a save/reload, transfer cages (h_type 17) must resume and each must get both of its hobgoblins (the bug left cages stuck with one). A cage is 'stuck' when it has exactly one live hobgoblin in two samples 600 frames apart (a cage legitimately has one for up to 60 frames while loading).

steps.why: let transfers get going so the save captures cages mid-cycle
